title: test(cli): dev-no-watch pin reports a failed child as itself and names pnpm's own PACKAGE refusal
body:
Fixes #22618
Clause-②: no

## What changed

One file, `packages/cli/test/dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts`. Test-only: nothing in `packages/cli`'s `files[]` (`dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) changes.

- **`runDev` reports a failed child as itself.** `Run` now carries `code: number | string | null` and `signal`, taken from `execFile`'s error as it is handed back: the exit status when there is one; `null` plus the signal for a signalled child; Node's own string code for a run that never produced an exit status (a spawn error such as `EAGAIN`, or `ERR_CHILD_PROCESS_STDIO_MAXBUFFER`). Before this change all of those read `1`.
- **Every spawned assertion prints the child's whole answer when it fails.** `told(run)` is passed as vitest's `expect(value, message)`, so a red reads `os dev ended with code …, signal …; its output (stdout, then stderr): …` instead of only `expected 1 to be +0`. The control is the case the card names. The siblings get the same message, because the tightened sibling-1 assertion below would otherwise be a second undiagnosable red.
- **Sibling 1 (`os dev --watch=false`) now names pnpm's own PACKAGE refusal.** `dev.ts` has no sentence of its own for a PACKAGE that selects nothing: `--fail-if-no-match` hands that answer to pnpm. On that path the CLI's `✗` line (`Development mode failed: Command failed: pnpm --filter false --fail-if-no-match dev`) is the catch-all for every failure of `pnpm … dev`, so it names `false` whether or not pnpm ever ran. The it-block now also asserts pnpm's own no-match line (`PNPM_NO_PROJECTS`, `/^No projects found in "/m`) and keeps the `false` check on the `✗` line.

⛔ No retry wrapper, no wider timeout, no product change. A real regression stays red, and the red now says why.

## Measured

All runs are on this branch at `d38422340`. The CLI child is the test's own (`tsx bin/run-dev.js dev`, the same fixture shapes, `NO_COLOR=1`).

**The card's sibling-1 claim, reproduced.** With pnpm off `PATH`, the `--watch=false` child still exits 1 and prints the same `✗` line. The only difference is that pnpm's own `No projects found in "DIR"` line is missing (stdout, exit 1; the same under pnpm 10.28.0 and 10.31.0), and `/bin/sh: 1: pnpm: not found` appears instead. Under the same `PATH` the control's child also exits 1, which is the CI red's exact reading, and only its stderr names pnpm.

"pnpm off `PATH`" means every `PATH` entry holding an executable `pnpm` is dropped, including pnpm's self-managed `~/.local/share/pnpm/.tools/pnpm/10.31.0/bin`, which `pnpm exec` puts on `PATH`. A first attempt that removed only `/opt/node22/bin` still resolved pnpm and ran 8/8 green. It does not count.

| run | input | result |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | normal `PATH` | 8/8 pass |
| R2 | pnpm off `PATH` | 2 fail, 6 pass: sibling 1's refusal assertion (`os dev ended with code 1, signal null; …` then `/bin/sh: 1: pnpm: not found`), and the control (the same message, then `expected 1 to be +0`) |
| A1 | pnpm off `PATH`, the `PNPM_NO_PROJECTS` assertion deleted (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `7e8e5de` to `49986f4`) | 1 fail, 7 pass: sibling 1 is green again, so that one line is what turns it red. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty |
| M1 | `timeout: 1` added to `runDev`'s `execFile` options | 4 fail, each reading `os dev ended with code null, signal "SIGTERM"`. Restored: blob equals HEAD |
| M2 | `maxBuffer: 16` | 4 fail, each reading `code "ERR_CHILD_PROCESS_STDIO_MAXBUFFER", signal null`. Restored: blob equals HEAD |

A1, M1 and M2 are one-time proofs; no permanent test was added for them. The subject under mutation is the test file itself, which vitest reads from disk, so no `dist/` sits on that path.

## Local verification (at `d38422340`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=2 test/dev-no-watch.pin.test.ts`: 8/8 pass. The file is integration-tier because it spawns.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: 277 files pass. Two files (`published-subpath-console.pin`, `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`) refused because `packages/cli/dist` was missing. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build` they pass (2/2 files, 29/29 tests), so the layer is 279/279 files.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck` OK. The file is in `tsconfig.test.json`'s program (`tsc --listFilesOnly`).
- Gates: the derived set (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 50 commands, identical to the dispatch's), plus `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing` and `check:filter-alias-parity`. All exit 0. Two first answered a prerequisite (exit 3) and passed once it was met: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (its pinned fixture commit fetched into the shallow clone) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (dists present). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 50 derived, 50 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `pnpm lint`, narrowed to the touched file, with the narrowing proven:
  - eslint's own config puts the file in the population (`isPathIgnored` false; `calculateConfigForFile` applies 5 rules);
  - `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on it counts 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings;
  - no config object enables type-aware linting (`parserOptions` is only `ecmaVersion`/`sourceType`), so the diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- Not merged with `main`, which is 5 commits ahead at `9f159397f`. None of those commits touches this file, `dev.ts`, `test/helpers/serve-process.ts`, `vitest.config.ts` or `vitest-tiers.ts`. CI and the queue run the merge ref.

## Acceptance notes

- The `✗` line's naming of `false` is still asserted. It holds because the catch-all echoes the command pnpm ran; the PACKAGE refusal itself is pnpm's line.
- If the next CI red of this file names a signal or a spawn error under load, that reading goes on #22618 (triage's direction). This PR does not give the control a budget of its own.
